paragraphs: R. Yudan, father of R. Mattanyah: Jerusalem Moed Katan, chapter 1, halakhah 7; Arba Mitot, halakhah 8 [the checked attestation is at Sanhedrin 7:6:4]; Demai 5:3. Beginning of chapter 3 of Kilayim has Mattalya [the checked text reads Mattanya]; Orlah, chapter 1; Challah, chapter 4; the chapter Rabbi Akiva in Shabbat; Shevuot, chapter 3; Avodah Zarah, beginnings of chapter 1 and chapter 3; beginning of Naarah SheNitpattatah. There are some scribal errors.
